latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ab-test-architect with the Test Velocity Method.

- Guides users through planning, prioritizing, and designing A/B tests using a rigorous, step-by-step framework.
- Includes support for hypothesis writing, sample size calculation, test duration, segmentation, and guardrail metric selection.
- Activates on a wide range of A/B testing queries, from landing pages and CTAs to emails and pricing pages.
- Offers a prioritization matrix (PIE/ICE scoring) and dev-ready, structured test plans.
- Ensures tests are built on clear evidence and measurable goals to avoid common CRO mistakes.
